# Lapwing

> Browser-only running app (TypeScript + Vite, no backend, no framework): draw routes on a map (MapLibre + BRouter), import and analyze runs (GPX, FIT or TCX files, plain or `.gz`; the whole Strava account export `.zip`, which needs no subscription; or optional Strava API sync, which requires a paid Strava subscription), training plans with structured workouts and watch export (ICS/TCX/FIT), history with filters, run comparison, goals/race predictions/overload alerts, light/dark theme, backup/restore. All user data stays in the browser (IndexedDB + localStorage, keys prefixed `lapwing:`). UI in pt-BR and en. Formerly called "Route Maker". A shoe-tracking screen exists in `src/screens/gear/` but is disabled (no route or menu entry).

The documentation is a tree under `docs/` written in Brazilian Portuguese. Every page starts with `<!-- docs-tree: <path> | parent: <index> -->`, a breadcrumb, a one-line summary and the related code paths. Start at the root index and descend by summary.
